patterns: APPSC asks AP-specific endemic flora (Boswellia ovalifoliolata vs non-AP distractors like Syzygium stocksii) and SV National Park statement items.
Statement items test area/year details (SV Sanctuary 525.97 sq km, declared 1989 not 1956) and endemic species of Seshachalam.
Expect site-district-feature matches: Koundinya (elephants, borders TN), Coringa mangroves, Kolleru Ramsar (2002), Rollapadu (Great Indian Bustard).
Trap: Kasu Brahmananda Reddy NP is in Telangana; NSTR is a tiger reserve, not a biosphere reserve.
App MCQs align with PYQ style; a few 2026 current-affairs items (safari ban, Hope Island) go beyond PYQ depth.
